newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Xiosbank cuts savings, home renovation loan.
newsitem.headline: Greek Xiosbank cuts savings, home renovation loan.

text.p: Greek private Xiosbank cut its home renovation loan rates by 100 basis points and its deposit rate by 50 basis to account for interbank market conditions and the course of inflation.
The rates for home renovation loans with and without lien will stand at 17.50 percent and 19 percent, respectively, it said. The deposit rate was cut to 9.50 percent
Its base business credit lending rate remained at 18.50 percent, it said.
Its XiosAlma deposit account, which pays interest monthly, will offer an annual yield of 11.02 percent for the week February 24 to March 2. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
